entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, your VeloFit specialist. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... I'm calling about a jersey I bought. I was so excited for it, but I finally tried it on and it's just... it's the wrong size.
I'm sorry to hear that it wasn't a perfect fit. I can definitely look into that for you. Can you tell me a bit more? Is it a technical issue with the material, or a preference issue with the fit?

It's just the fit. It's way too tight across the chest. I feel terrible about it, I've had it for a little while and I was just so hoping it would work. I've been a loyal customer for so long and I feel bad even calling.
Please don't feel bad at all, that's what we're here for. Getting the right fit is the most important thing. Just so I can check our policy, can you tell me when you received the item?
I think it was delivered about 54 days ago. I know that's a long time... I really needed the money back, things have been a bit tight lately.
I completely understand. Let me just pull up the policy for that jersey. One moment... Okay, I have good news. That item falls under our standard 90-day return policy.
Yes, absolutely. You are well within the window. We can definitely process this for you. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like to do an exchange for a different size?
Oh, a refund would be amazing! Thank you so much, Diana. I was so worried I was just stuck with it. This is such a relief.

Of course. I'm happy I could help you out. I'm sending the return shipping label to the email we have on file for you now. Just pack the jersey back in its original packaging if you can and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
That's perfect. You've really made my day. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Have a wonderful day and thank you for being a VeloFit customer.
